_comment: CP2 Hole library. Identification content (what is this opening?), not factual claims, so no sources are required; reveal lines are Graham's opinions. Images are project-owned procedural illustrations (provisional art). Candidate order is shuffled per round by the server; the first entry is NOT special. 'studio_hole' items are the rare Studio Hole crossover: never explain them.
